description: Upgrade plan to migrate project to latest LTS versions

tasks.description: Upgrade to Java 25 and Spring Boot 4.x
tasks.requirements: Upgrade the application to Java 25, Spring Boot 4.x, and Spring Framework 7.x. Migrate Java EE APIs from javax.* to jakarta.* where required.
tasks.taskSummary: Upgraded the project to Java 25, Spring Boot 4.1.2, and Spring Framework 7.0.10; migrated persistence and validation APIs to Jakarta; updated the security configuration, Oracle JDBC driver, Docker images, and documentation; and added security regression tests. Clean Java 25 verification passed with all 4 tests passing. A full CVE scan was unavailable.
